requirements.expected: All Categories renders each visible SECTIONS category divider at most once even when chronologically adjacent prompts revisit that category later.
Selecting one category renders only matching prompts beneath that category heading.
All Types plus one unique control per prompt type is available.

Selecting the top-level All view by click or keyboard shortcut 1 is an atomic reset: category becomes all, Favorites/category section scope is cleared, type and color filters are cleared, search is cleared, collapsed sections are expanded, All Categories and All Types are reselected, and the complete prompt stream is rendered. Favorites then All must never remain Favorites-filtered.

The complete visible prompt-card stream is sorted by numeric prompt sequence after search/category/type/color/Favorites filtering; missing numbers do not create placeholders. Category metadata may group counts and collapse state but must not reorder cards.

Every visible category divider carries Top-left and Bottom-right same-document anchors without clearing filters, while distributed list navigation supplies additional Top/Bottom access through long result sets.

The repository documents zero-dialog one-click acquisition, the advanced acquisition GUI, existing-checkout update, fresh clone, ZIP download, Actions preview, canonical artifact path, and rebuild/parity commands.

proof_ceiling: Source, deterministic reset/grouping/order/mobile tests, generated-site parity, and CI artifact proof; real operator browser and physical mobile acceptance remain field gates.
